name: Ideological Preparation for the Full-Scale Invasion (2020–2021) (C0102)

techniques.comment: Total indoctrination of Russian society with the ideas of the philosopher I. Ilyin (so-called "white fascism") and the transformation of the "Russian World" concept into a state ideology (rashism) that justifies the metropole's cultural superiority and existential right to violence against its neighbors(Citation: Рашизм: Звір з безодні 2023).

An article by D. Medvedev, deputy chairman of Russia's Security Council, in Kommersant (11 October 2021) marginalizing the Ukrainian leadership: "it is pointless for us to deal with vassals. One must do business with the suzerain"; "at the head of Ukraine stand weak people who strive only to line their own pockets," and negotiations with them are "absolutely pointless"(Citation: Почему бессмысленны контакты с нынешним украинским руководством 2021). In the same text the Ukrainian president was likened to a hypothetical Jew serving in the SS(Citation: Почему бессмысленны контакты с нынешним украинским руководством 2021).

The official denial of the Ukrainian nation's right to independent statehood: the article by the head of the Russian state declares outright that "Ukraine's genuine sovereignty is possible precisely in partnership with Russia," while "the wall that has arisen in recent years between Russia and Ukraine" is declared a split of "between parts of what is essentially one historical and spiritual space"(Citation: Статья Владимира Путина «Об историческом единстве русских и украинцев» 2021).

The publication of the manifesto "On the Historical Unity of Russians and Ukrainians" (July 2021), constructing a pseudo-historical myth: "Russians and Ukrainians are one people, a single whole," while modern borders are declared the result of the fact that "the Bolsheviks' actions in severing from Russia its historical territories are not considered a criminal act"(Citation: Статья Владимира Путина «Об историческом единстве русских и украинцев» 2021). The same article describes how Lenin personally "persuaded" the leaders of the Donetsk-Kryvyi Rih republic "to act within Soviet Ukraine," and how the Central Committee resolved "to create at the congress 'one government for all of Ukraine'"(Citation: Статья Владимира Путина «Об историческом единстве русских и украинцев» 2021). On the eve of the invasion the thesis was taken to its limit: in his address of February 21, 2022 Putin declared that "modern Ukraine was entirely and wholly created by Russia, or, to be more precise, by Bolshevik, communist Russia," and called the country "Ukraine named after Vladimir Ilyich Lenin" - "He is its author and architect"(Citation: Обращение Президента Российской Федерации 21 февраля 2022 года 2022).
